name: auth_feature
title: Add Multi-Provider Authentication
description: Implement OAuth2 (Google, GitHub) and Apple Sign-In with role-based access control. Support session management, token refresh, and secure credential storage following the port/adapter pattern.

requirements.description: Support OAuth2 authentication for Google and GitHub providers
Implement role-based access control with admin, editor, and viewer roles
Secure token storage using Keychain Services
Automatic token refresh before expiry with configurable buffer
Session timeout after 30 minutes of inactivity
Response time under 200ms for authentication flows
All auth operations must be auditable with structured logging

constraints: Must follow port/adapter pattern per CLAUDE.md
Zero framework imports in domain layer
No business logic in SwiftUI views or controllers
